note: The game's copy of the Act II site categories and flaws (scope 0.2 §2.6; doc 18 §6). From docs/game-project-files/claude_act2-content_sites_act2.json (the pack, used as it is; its real_examples are left there). Greenfield's price is text in the pack ('≈$0.5-2M/MW upfront'); its range is written out here. Energized land's price_usd_mw below is the pack's price_usd_mw_announced (an announced AI project's EV band); the game doesn't use it: it prices energized land as land (balance.ts › act2Scouting.energizedLand, owner 28 Sep 2026).

site_categories.source: Argo->Galaxy Helios: $65M facility sale (Dec 2022) implying ≈$325k/MW; CleanSpark comparable distressed-site pricing $270-500k/MW (estimate)
market-implied at deal-announcement stage; Cipher Mining's 313MW priced at $2.9M/MW (Jun 2026); the pack's price_usd_mw_announced
the pack: land + interconnection deposit only, ≈$0.5-2M/MW upfront (site control) before any shell capex; energized after the region's grid queue

queue_position_lost.basis: PJM ~7yr average wait (electricchoice.com); losing queue position on a re-purposed distressed site is a real, documented risk

water_limits.basis: liquid-cooled AI retrofit needs far more water than ASIC air-cooling; several 2025-26 siting fights cite water use explicitly

fibre_distance.basis: AI shell conversions need far more network bandwidth than mining; remote crypto sites often lack it

air_permit_for_gas.basis: xAI Memphis Colossus: unpermitted gas turbines, NAACP/SELC legal action 2025-26

zoning_challenge.basis: Prince William Digital Gateway: zoning voided by a court over a newspaper-notice technicality; Compass and QTS/Blackstone both exited in 2026

tenant_unfit_power_quality.basis: mining-grade power delivery is less clean than what dense GPU racks need

undersized_transformer.basis: carried over from Act I sites.json flaw of the same name, scaled to Act II costs

title_defect.basis: typical bankruptcy-auction risk; several 2022-23 crypto-miner asset sales carried disputed liens
